lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12-15 high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid formation along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a visible lattice of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges running parallel to the dorsal midline, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light upper edge to a shadowed lower boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense, small-diameter high-luminance speckling on the pectoral fin surface and anterior head region, contrasting with the larger, sparse lateral blobs.
